sentence: This project tries to find out how cryogenic semiconductor devices work at low temperatures and builds models that help design them.
This project studies how small handed molecules mixed with plastics that conduct electricity change the way the materials twist light.
This project builds learning methods that make decisions aiming for good average outcomes while also limiting risk to individuals.
This project builds mathematical and artificial intelligence methods that make imaging with waves more accurate, including imaging of tissue.
This project studies how events are made of smaller parts in videos and builds an agent that uses this to understand what people are doing.
This project builds a system of ultracold polar molecules held in crystals made of laser light to learn how superconductivity and quantum magnetism work.
This project studies how genes on the X chromosome in female cells affect stiffening of the aortic valve, using hydrogels that mimic soft tissue.
This project builds methods that use quantum computers and quantum ideas to solve partial differential equations faster.
This project studies how the immune system of larval zebrafish flares up during inflammation and builds mathematical models of these responses.
This project studies how the microorganisms in soil crusts of dry lands respond to changes in temperature.
This project builds on research into ransomware, blockchain technology, and information authenticity.
This project studies how architected materials made of a soft solid and a liquid respond mechanically to outside influences.
This project builds automated reasoning tools that handle counting constraints directly, so problems can be written in a more natural form.
This project builds devices on a chip that control laser light for trapped ions used in quantum computing.
This project explores how an electronic grid that moves small droplets can be used to store data in DNA and to compute with DNA.
This project builds a course track on securing artificial intelligence systems and on using artificial intelligence to detect threats.
This project holds a conference where biomedical engineers share work on cells, tissue, medical imaging and medical devices.
This project studies how a thin region called the plasma sheath forms where plasma touches a boundary, in plasmas with multiple ion species.
